description:
This is such a simple way to start making Gelato in your Ninja Creami. Is it "perfect" gelato? Nope absolutely not! Is it deliciously easy and simple? YEP 👍👍

This has to be where the ninja creami comes in to it's own, I wish others balanced their recipes a little more though but hey........that's why am here I guess!

Want me to make something specific in the Ninja Creami? Comment below and tell me what it is. 

For those that "need" the recipe (i mean it's 3 ingredients...) :
550g Half n Half
350g Condensed Milk
10g Vanilla Extract/mint/coffee/Lemon etc (you can also use glycerine based extracts but you'll need to use 50% more).

MASSIVE thanks to all ym supporters on both Patreon and Ko-Fi, I really could NOT do this without you all!!

TOne of my sons is lactose intolerant. Initially figured I'd buy lactose free milk. Read ingredients to check sugar levels and discovered they are the same as other milk. Figure that's because lactose is just being converted to another sugar. Also saw lactase was used. Decided to check into making my own lactose free. 

Did some research, and it looks like Milkaide drops is the best. 3 drops in 500ml for 24hrs = 70%. 10 drops yields 99%. Also realized that milk is not the only lactose. Heavy cream, cream cheese, condensed milk, etc. would all have to be delt with. Figured the genius solution is to stick with regular milk/cream, etc, make the recipe, cool, then add the lactase at the end to the finished base, based on the total volume, then leave it in the frig for 24 hours before churning. This insures ALL the lactose gets converted, except possibly the add-ins, which are more manageable. Would like your thoughts in this idea.

Im also replacing sugars with Allulose, including making invert syrup and Golden Syrup to replace corn syrup, etc, with it. Is there a Dextrose replacement using Allulose?
